instruction: Using command-line tools, compress the image to reduce its file size below 100KB and save it as "compressed.jpg" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires compressing tilearray.png to below 100KB (102400 bytes) using command-line tools (e.g., ImageMagick convert -quality 50). The evaluator uses existing check_image_file_size metric which verifies the file size is below the threshold.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_image_file_size metric from gimp.py which checks if file size < max_size threshold (100KB).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the primary requirement: file size < 100KB using check_image_file_size metric
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly extracts the target file from /home/user/Desktop/compressed.jpg
Expected value (max_size: 102400) correctly represents 100KB threshold matching instruction
File path verification ensures correct filename (compressed.jpg) and location (desktop)
Logic handles missing file case correctly (returns 0.0 when src_path is None)
Comparison operator uses strict '<' which correctly implements 'below 100KB' requirement
No UI state dependencies, no postconfig needed - file persists after command execution
